title: Master Inventory Density Refinement
summary: Tightens the Master Kitchen Inventory matrix to reduce depth and add clear Have and Buy counter headings.
behavior: Moves the first form column left by narrowing the storage-type label column.
Keeps each form and counting unit on one thin line.
Reduces row and numeric-counter heights and divides the two form columns evenly.
Changes family notes to a single-line field.
Adds Have and Buy headings above both quantity-counter columns in every food-family section.
